title: Normalized Fractional Order Entropy-Based Decision-Making Models under Risk
summary: Constructing efficient portfolios requires balancing expected returns with risk through optimal stock selection, while accounting for investor preferences. In a recent work by Paul and Kundu (2026), the fractional-order entropy due to Ubriaco was introduced as an uncertainty measure to capture varying investor attitudes toward risk. Building on this foundation, we introduce a novel normalized fractional order entropy aligned with investors' risk preferences that combines normalized fractional entropy with expected utility and variance.
